China's J-20 Stealth Fighter Faces Combat Readiness Challenges

China's J-20 fifth-generation stealth fighter, while a marvel of modern aviation, faces significant upkeep demands. Its advanced features, such as radar-absorbing materials, can degrade over time, posing challenges for maintenance specialists. The F-35 Lightning II is cited as an example of similar complex maintenance requirements. Discussions are also ongoing regarding potential upgrades for China's J-35A stealth fighter, including enhanced power and weaponry.
